_note: Per-symbol Binance USDT-M min notional (USDT) and stepSize (qty). Real values from Binance Demo exchangeInfo, fetched on a Cloud Run run (crypto-shadow-ab). min_notional = MIN_NOTIONAL.notional; step_size = max(LOT_SIZE, MARKET_LOT_SIZE).stepSize. Symbols not listed on Demo futures (delisted) fall back to default. Override path via env MIN_NOTIONAL_JSON.
